title: Receipt and billed miles
prompt: The rider's receipt rounds each trip's distance to one decimal place with halves going up, but the billing system sends halves to the even digit. Write `solve(trips)` so it returns `trip_id`, `receipt_miles` and `billed_miles`.
rules: `receipt_miles` is `trip_distance` rounded to 1 decimal place, a half going up: 2.25 is 2.3.
`billed_miles` is `trip_distance` rounded to 1 decimal place, a half going to the even digit: 2.25 is 2.2.
Both stay doubles. A missing distance gives missing miles. Return the three columns, in that order.
hints: `F.bround(col, 1)` sends a half to the even digit.
